compatibility.policy: append-only; every v1.6 address, value encoding, and counter meaning is retained

m7_overlap.word_order: low 32 bits at counter offset, high 32 bits at counter offset + 4
m7_overlap.access: read-only; every write in 0x810..0x8E4 returns AXI-Lite SLVERR
m7_overlap.snapshot_policy: Only the published bank is readable. Reset clears live and published state. An accepted START clears live counters, the prior published snapshot, overflow, typed errors, and claim history, sets running, and clears snapshot-valid. While running, live updates are not exposed. DONE while running atomically publishes terminal-cycle-inclusive counters, overflow, typed errors, and claim history, clears running, and sets snapshot-valid.
m7_overlap.read_consistency: Published 64-bit counters remain stable between DONE and the next accepted START or reset, so low/high reads cannot tear within that interval. Software should require STATUS.snapshot_valid=1 and STATUS.running=0 before consuming a snapshot.
m7_overlap.overflow_policy: Additive counters wrap modulo 2^64 and set a sticky per-counter overflow bit. Overflow bits are published atomically on DONE and clear on reset or the next accepted START. Maximum gauges retain the largest observed value and do not add event deltas.
m7_overlap.typed_error_policy: Typed error events are sticky within the live epoch, publish atomically on DONE, and clear on reset or the next accepted START. Additional consistency checks are generated internally on the terminal cycle.
m7_overlap.current_production_limit: The production wrapper instantiates two operand banks, RESULT_FIFO_DEPTH=0, and GENERATION_BITS=0. Result-FIFO counter/register slots are reserved and readable but production FIFO events are not driven; no production result FIFO or generation-tag protection is claimed by v1.9.

capability_bits.15:8: counter width in bytes; 0x08 means 64-bit counters
capability_bits.20: accepted and disabled FP16 term deltas present
capability_bits.22: result-FIFO observability implemented; clear in current production
capability_bits.23: generation-tag observability implemented; clear in current production

status_bits.2: one or more published counter-overflow bits set
status_bits.3: one or more published typed-error bits set
status_bits.4: published load/compute overlap counter is nonzero
status_bits.5: published compute/store overlap counter is nonzero
status_bits.6: published three-way overlap counter is nonzero
status_bits.7: both operand-bank claim bits were observed in the published epoch
status_bits.9:8: published operand-bank claim-seen mask; bit 8 is bank 0 and bit 9 is bank 1
status_bits.11:10: low two bits of published maximum operand-bank occupancy
status_bits.15:12: low four bits of published maximum result-FIFO occupancy; zero in current production
status_bits.20: published numerical-error summary: error bits 10..13 or bit 19 are set
status_bits.21: published control/ownership/consistency-error summary: error bits 0..9 or 14..18 are set

overflow_bits.22:0: bits 0..22 correspond one-for-one to M7 counter indices 0..22

error_status_bits.2:0: reserved typed ownership/protocol error slots; no production driver in v1.9
error_status_bits.3: ownership/tag/protocol mismatch class; current production driver is an A-vector-cache response or coordinate protocol violation
error_status_bits.9:4: reserved typed ownership/protocol error slots; no production driver in v1.9
error_status_bits.10: one or more FP16 invalid-result events observed
error_status_bits.11: one or more FP16 overflow-result events observed
error_status_bits.12: one or more FP16 length-error events observed
error_status_bits.13: one or more FP16 subnormal-flushed events observed
error_status_bits.14: DONE observed with nonzero operand-bank occupancy; generated internally
error_status_bits.15: DONE observed with nonzero result-FIFO occupancy; generated internally
error_status_bits.16: DONE observed while load, compute, or store stage-active was asserted; generated internally
error_status_bits.17: reserved consistency-error slot; no production driver in v1.9
error_status_bits.18: disabled-term delta exceeded accepted-term delta in a cycle; generated internally
error_status_bits.19: aggregate fatal numerical event from invalid, overflow, or length error

buffer_config_bits.23:16: generation-tag width in bits; current production value 0

numeric_config_bits.7:0: accumulator width in bits; current value 93
numeric_config_bits.15:8: signed accumulator least-significant binary exponent in two's-complement; current value -48
numeric_config_bits.23:16: maximum K divided by 16; current value 192 for Kmax=3072

counters.name: fp16_term_accepts
counters.meaning: Sum of m7_fp16_term_accept_delta, including enabled and disabled accepted stream slots.

counters.name: fp16_disabled_term_accepts
counters.meaning: Sum of accepted stream slots disabled by tail or padding; useful accepted terms equal counter 0 minus counter 1 when no consistency error is present.

counters.name: fp16_dot_start_cycles
counters.meaning: Cycles in which m7_fp16_dot_start is asserted.

counters.name: fp16_result_vector_cycles
counters.meaning: Cycles in which m7_fp16_result_vector is asserted.

counters.name: fp16_feeder_stall_cycles
counters.meaning: Cycles in which m7_fp16_input_wait or m7_fp16_term_stall is asserted; simultaneous causes count once.

counters.name: fp16_result_backpressure_cycles
counters.meaning: Cycles in which m7_fp16_result_backpressure is asserted.

counters.name: panel_load_active_cycles
counters.meaning: Cycles with M7 panel-load stage active.

counters.name: panel_compute_active_cycles
counters.meaning: Cycles with M7 panel-compute stage active.

counters.name: panel_store_active_cycles
counters.meaning: Cycles with M7 panel-store stage active.

counters.name: panel_stage_union_cycles
counters.meaning: Cycles with at least one of panel load, compute, or store active.

counters.name: panel_load_compute_overlap_cycles
counters.meaning: Cycles with panel load and compute simultaneously active.

counters.name: panel_compute_store_overlap_cycles
counters.meaning: Cycles with panel compute and store simultaneously active.

counters.name: panel_load_store_overlap_cycles
counters.meaning: Cycles with panel load and store simultaneously active.

counters.name: panel_three_way_overlap_cycles
counters.meaning: Cycles with panel load, compute, and store all simultaneously active.

counters.name: operand_bank_commits
counters.meaning: Cycles in which a packed-panel load commit is reported.

counters.name: operand_bank_claims
counters.meaning: Cycles in which compute claims a committed packed-panel bank.

counters.name: operand_bank_releases
counters.meaning: Cycles in which compute releases a packed-panel bank.

counters.name: operand_bank_empty_wait_cycles
counters.meaning: Cycles in which packed compute waits because no committed operand bank is ready.

counters.name: operand_bank_full_wait_cycles
counters.meaning: Cycles in which packed load waits because no operand bank is free.

counters.name: operand_bank_max_occupancy
counters.meaning: Maximum observed two-bit m7_panel_occupancy value in the epoch.

counters.name: result_fifo_enqueues
counters.meaning: Reserved count of cycles with a result-FIFO enqueue. Current production has no result FIFO and drives this event low.

counters.name: result_fifo_dequeues
counters.meaning: Reserved count of cycles with a result-FIFO dequeue. Current production has no result FIFO and drives this event low.

counters.name: result_fifo_max_occupancy
counters.meaning: Reserved maximum observed result-FIFO occupancy. Current production has FIFO depth zero and drives occupancy zero.

derived_invariants.useful_fp16_terms: counter[0] - counter[1], valid only when ERROR_STATUS bit 18 is clear
derived_invariants.stage_inclusion_exclusion: counter[9] = counter[6] + counter[7] + counter[8] - counter[10] - counter[11] - counter[12] + counter[13]

protected_windows.name: v1_6_and_earlier
